t: General expenses: For an additional amount for “General expenses”, $43,000,000.

fable.w: This section is a bare appropriation of an additional $43,000,000 for "General expenses". There is no tempting reading here: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, right to sue, or any party outside the federal government taking part in a federal decision.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation clause authorizing a specific amount of funding for general expenses. It does not establish any process for consultation, coordination, or participation with entities outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or requirements for outside input mentioned.
qwen_block.s: General expenses: For an additional amount for “General expenses”, $43,000,000.

opus.w: This section only provides an additional $43,000,000 appropriation for "General expenses." opus.b: This is a bare appropriation line. Nothing in it tempts a "Yes" reading: it names no outside party, no consultation, no hearing, no rulemaking, and no right to sue.
